name: Bézier Clipping for Metaball Ray Casting
definition: A method to compute the coefficients of the density function for a single metaball intersecting a viewing ray, and then for N intersecting metaballs, using Bézier clipping to determine the ray-isosurface intersection.
summary: Bézier Clipping for Metaball Ray Casting computes ray-isosurface intersections by representing density as a Bézier polynomial and iteratively clipping the domain to find roots without derivatives.
